query: Using 'player_goals_imbalance_train.csv' as the training set and 'player_goals_imbalance_test.csv' as the test set, preprocess the data as needed and train several classification models (for example, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost if available) to predict 'goals_label' (1 or 0). Use only numerical feature columns and fill missing values with 0. Compare the models on the training and validation data, select the best-performing classifier, and report: (1) the metric used to select the best model and its validation score, (2) the name of the selected model, (3) the model performance on the test set.

Using 'player_goals_imbalance_train.csv' as the training set and 'player_goals_imbalance_test.csv' as the test set, preprocess the data as needed and train several classification models (for example, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost if available) to predict 'goals_label' (1 or 0). Use only numerical feature columns and fill missing values with 0. The target class is highly imbalanced: only about 5% of players are labeled as 1. Compare the models on the training and validation data, select the best-performing classifier, and report: (1) the metric used to select the best model and its validation score, (2) the name of the selected model, (3) the model performance on the test set.
